summary: Mapped FACTORY_WORKER/PRODUCTION_WORKER/WORKER to FACTORY_WORKER (not PRODUCTION) and DISPATCH to STORE in CANONICAL_ROLE_V2_MAP and ui_role; replaced OR-union loop in has_permission with single-matrix least-privilege specificity resolution via _resolve_builtin_permission_matrix and effective_permissions_for; added explicit FACTORY_WORKER HTTP 403 guard in require_production_access.

Added FACTORY_WORKER to PRODUCTION_READ_ROLES to preserve view-only production reads; kept PRODUCTION_ROLES write set exclusive of FACTORY_WORKER; added defense-in-depth is_factory_worker HTTP 403 denial in require_production_access.
Updated GET /api/v2/meta/capabilities to return effective_permissions_for(current_user) so FACTORY_WORKER accurately reports view-only production permissions.

Added 12-scenario targeted security test suite covering FACTORY_WORKER view-only enforcement, create/edit/approve/alternate-route 403 denials, canonical and legacy alias non-elevation, least-privilege matrix precedence, forged JWT AuthUsers override, and preservation of PRODUCTION/PACKAGING/PA/OWNER_ADMIN access.
Added isFactoryWorkerRole helper and changed DESIGNATIONS.production_worker.canEditProduction from true to false to align UI metadata with backend view-only enforcement.
Guarded canSubmitCheck with !isFactoryWorkerRole(currentUser?.role) so FACTORY_WORKER users are not shown QC submission controls rejected by the backend.
